title: Same-universe abelian etale inverse-image adjunction
statement: For schemes X and Y in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme] and any morphism g : Y -> X, there is a functor H from abelian etale sheaves on X to abelian etale sheaves on Y, both with coefficients AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], together with an adjunction H left adjoint to the direct image that evaluates a sheaf on each base-changed etale object. No higher coefficient universe is required.

source.place: Abelian-sheaf adjunction in the proof; Sites and Sheaves, Proposition 7.44.3, after passage to small affine presentation sites.

proof.text: Use the essentially small affine etale category and its cover-dense Spec functor. Replace this category by its small model in the scheme universe; equip that model with the topology induced from the affine etale topology. Restriction along the small-model equivalence and along AffineEtale.Spec are equivalences on abelian sheaves (Mathlib Sites.Equivalence and AffineEtale).

Compose the small-model inclusion with g.Etale. Functor.isContinuous_comp gives continuity. The source is a small category in the coefficient universe and the target site has HasSheafify by Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.AffineEtale. AddCommGrpCat has the required colimits, hence the pointwise left Kan extensions exist (Functor.KanExtension.Pointwise). The instance in Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction constructs a left adjoint by left Kan extension followed by sheafification.

Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousComp identifies this right adjoint with the original direct image followed by restriction to the small affine model. Restriction is an equivalence, so Functor.isRightAdjoint_comp_iff_left cancels it. Extract IsRightAdjoint.exists_leftAdjoint to obtain exactly the required functor and nonempty adjunction.

proof_origin.place: AffineEtale small-model restriction and sheaf equivalence; sheafPullbackConstruction right-adjoint instance; isRightAdjoint_comp_iff_left
